notes.title: Beta is out!
notes.content:
We've released the beta version of RV Kingdom 0x0297. The playtest has started.

[b]How to participate?[/b]
You can apply for participation on the Steam store page. Then, we will choose some limited number of players to be beta testers.

[b]What will beta testers be able to do?[/b]
They will get access to the beta version of the game that we will periodically update. 
The beta now includes:
[list]
[*]2 classes to play as (hero and monk)
[*]115 mobs including 10 bosses
[*]About 60 NPC in different locations
[*]1 game ending
[/list]

[b]For beta testers[/b]
If you find any bug or localization issue in the game, please let us now [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2520130/discussions/0/4362373279647384783/]here[/url].

notes.title: The Beta Test Announcement
notes.content:
The main story of RV Kingdom 0x0297 is almost complete which means the beta test is coming soon. We  will choose few testers to improve the gameplay experience. 

[b]What's next?[/b]
During the beta, we will update the game adding new features. We still have many things we want to add to the game which includes: 
1.Many characters the player will be able to play as
2.New side quests including some lore-rich storylines
3.New locations that player will be able to explore
4.Various game endings
5.Bug fix and gameplay improvements based on the testers' feedback

We will try to make the game as good as we can and we hope you will enjoy it. If you like RV Kingdom, add it to your wishlist and follow the news.
